note: Which pipeline stage each authoring .blend actually represents. The shipped GLB is not an export of any committed .blend: D2-D4 retimed and reshaped clips and C5 rebalanced skin weights at GLB level, so a blend stamped below shippedStages cannot reproduce public/models/wyvern-v2-rig.glb. cmd_export refuses to write the shipped asset from such a blend.

blends.reason: Built in Task C1 (5fb3ab1) from tools/blender/build_v2_master_blend.py, then edited by Task C6 (tools/blender/fix_c6_jaw_pivot_and_stub_bones.py): the Jaw hinge moved to the midline mandible joint with a lateral local X, and Body grew from a 0.05-unit stub to Spine1.head. C6 is a blend-level stage, so it is not in shippedStages and the shipped GLB still carries the old jaw pivot. D2 (takeoff/death), D3 (idle/walk/attack2 motion floor), D4 (attack amplitude + flight-group retime) and C5 (skin-weight rebalance) were applied at GLB level only, so exporting this blend replaces public/models/wyvern-v2-rig.glb with a C1+C6 asset and silently reverts all four stages.
